attributes.name: Lance of Jousting
attributes.powers: For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d8+1. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4. On this check, you may reveal a card that has the Mount trait to ignore the 2-Handed trait on this card; if you do and this is your first combat check of the turn, add another 1d8+1. If you would fail this check, you may recharge this card to reroll the dice; take the new result.
